Friendly hello all,
The welfare officer sent an update on visitor flow

The welfare officer sent an update on visitor flow, and it is worth keeping our desk habits tight when the lobby gets busier. Please keep guidance short, calm, and easy to follow at the counter, especially when families are juggling carriers, paperwork, and last minute concerns about pet comfort. If a traveler looks unsure, slow the pace a little and restate the next step in plain language. That helps prevent avoidable mistakes and keeps the handoff clean for the rest of the team.

Please also watch the usual safety points around crate handling, water checks, and carrier labeling. Small oversights create bigger problems once an animal is on the move, so the standard checks still matter even on routine trips. If you spot a missing detail, flag it early and keep the conversation friendly but direct. We are not here to make the process complicated, only reliable. The Companion Animal Travel Desk works best when we stay consistent, attentive, and quick to correct anything that could affect welfare.

Aurelia Skyways depends on this desk to be warm and professional without drifting into vague advice. When a traveler needs clarity, give the clean version first and avoid extra chatter. If a case feels unusual, bring it to the senior coordinator rather than improvising. That keeps the desk steady and protects the animals in our care.
